notes: §1985:VI.6.12.3 SR1: 'Language-name-1 is specified by the implementor.' WiseOwl specifies no language: the ENTER statement is not provided (§1985:I.1.5.2.5.5 leaves it to the implementor; GnuCOBOL refuses it, CLAUDE.md rule 1; docs/conformance/3.7.1). StatementBinder#BindEnter refuses every ENTER at 85 with COBOL7240, so ENTER FORTRAN SUBRTN. no longer compiles to nothing (kb/Work PB5308); witness: the refusal 1985-SR-VI_6_12_3-1 (refuse-at 85, COBOL7240) and the declined construct row enter-removed-2002.
